title: Senior Field Marketing Manager (London)
description: Developers don’t want more marketing. They want relevance, technical depth, and experiences worth showing up for. As Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will help bring Coder’s regional marketing programs to life. You will execute field and ABM programs that build awareness, support sales, and create pipeline across the European market. You will work closely with a Senior Marketing Manager, sales, partners, and the broader marketing team. You will coordinate events, activate campaigns, and keep programs moving on time and on brand.
